mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a preemptive equity risk premium, pushing S&P 500 forward returns positive over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) during inflation spikes above 0.3%, or CPIAUCSL does not revert to below 0.3% within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS outpaces wage growth (UNRATE), signaling labor market strength that supports equity valuations and drives positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth rate > UNRATE growth rate over the current month
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, returns are negative or flat despite consistent PAYEMS > UNRATE growth, or unemployment falls below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 suggests weakening demand, which typically precedes a short-term S&P 500 decline over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not revert to above 100 within 10 days, and 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in retail sales (HOUST) above trend for two consecutive months indicates resilient consumer demand, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST monthly value above 12-month rolling mean for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are flat or negative despite sustained HOUST above trend.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains above 4% for three consecutive months, the S&P 500 is expected to underperform over the next 60 trading days due to persistent rate hikes eroding risk premium.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the high-rate period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4.0% triggers a wage-price spiral, boosting equity valuations and producing positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses below 4.0% in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative or flat despite UNRATE < 4.0% persisting for 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A double-dip in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 in two consecutive months signals supply-side weakness that precedes a 5-day S&P 500 drop.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not revert to above 100 within 7 days, and 5-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising RSAFS (reserves) above 4,000M indicate central banks are proactively supporting markets, which tends to drive positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not positive during the reserve accumulation period (p > 0.05).
